name: Christian Medinilla
title: Software Engineer & Engineering Leader
profile: Software engineer and engineering leader with 14 years of experience, growing from .NET developer to Practice Director and now Staff Engineer. I combine hands-on full stack development (React, TypeScript, Node.js, C#/.NET Core, SQL Server, AWS and Azure) with technical design, architecture and ownership of code quality. Experienced managing managers, tech leads and engineers, owning delivery on client accounts, and acting as the bridge between technical and business stakeholders on both the company and client side. Built and led a graduate program covering candidate selection, hiring and a 6-month training path into client projects.
